newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Amer Jan-April seen in the red.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Amer Jan-April seen in the red.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a median forecast of a 53 million markka loss after financial items for sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy in January-April.
Amer's four-month results are due on May 29 in the afternoon. In January-April 1996, Amer posted a 114 million markka loss.
In February, Amer said it expected group full-year 1997 earnings to improve from the 1996 level, but may remain in the red.

The median of seven analysts' forecasts for Amer's full-year 1997 result was a loss of 20 million markka (mean 32 million loss) in a range from a loss of 110 million markka to a profit of 10 million markka. In 1996, Amer's loss before extraordinary items and tax was 234 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Evli Securities, Merita, Opstock, Erik Selin and Handelbanken.
